phase: prospective extension after the already observed Hand case
target: Short empirical software-engineering paper; no venue or acceptance claim
sampling: Purposive fixed list of eight official MediaPipe download targets chosen for task and interface diversity; not a prevalence sample. Recursively enumerate .tflite task members and deduplicate by component SHA-256. Retain failed downloads, absent metadata, unsupported generation, and native-tool failures as outcomes.

contract_rules.S_count: Use official MetadataPopulator's public load/populate path as structural baseline. MetadataDisplayer parsing alone does not establish acceptance.
contract_rules.I_index: Only claim semantic output-index mismatch when a component-specific official execution contract supplies intended index/role. Otherwise abstain; tensor shape alone is not a semantic classifier.
contract_rules.D_decoder: For a generated get*AsCategoryList expression that actually uses new TensorLabel(List<String>, TensorBuffer), require a positive axis greater than 1, equality of its length to label count, and compatibility with getCategoryList's effective-last-axis requirement. Scope to this consumer API, not universal metadata validity.
contract_rules.P_preservation: Verify all non-metadata buffers unchanged and canonical graph identity after each intervention. Associated-label mutations are separately classified from embedded-metadata-only changes.

variants: description-only one-character same-length metadata edit when an existing description is available, as a binding/cardinality negative control
reduce populated output metadata vector count by one without changing graph outputs, as a structural rejection positive control
swap first lexicographic pair of populated output metadata entries whose actual output shapes differ, when applicable
for each TensorLabel category output with at least two labels, remove the last line of its associated label file, preserving graph and metadata tables; not a newly discovered natural defect
generation: Isolate native code generation in subprocesses and retain diagnostics. Record generated field/index associations. Raw compilation for eligible representative category consumers; do not automatically transplant Hand's syntax repair to new models.
runtime: For original and structurally accepted applicable variants, attempt CPU interpreter inference with zero, constant 0.5, and seeded uniform float32 inputs, or quantized equivalents. Use one thread and preserve raw inputs/outputs. Failures and unsupported operators are retained; no silent omission. Computational equality is empirical and not an accuracy test.
decoder_probe: Run official TensorLabel on preserved raw output buffers for applicable generated category outputs. Compare rule predictions with isolated host-JVM success/exception; this validates an API precondition check, not a general model-quality detector.
outcome_reporting: Separate natural baseline failures, seeded mutations, negative controls, structural controls, absent evidence, and unsupported tool paths. Do not combine duplicate components, label mutants, or inference invocations into a model prevalence denominator.
limits: Known Hand case informed the rules; extension is not an independent discovery study
Public literature and tool comparison remains scoped rather than exhaustive
No Android or real-user impact claim
No independent human annotation or validation claim
